svg.aria-label: What gets raised. Each scheduled run pulls candidate items from the connected sources, among them messages, mail, calendar, GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, arXiv, RSS feeds, weather, markets, and seismic feeds. Every item is scored for relevance, materiality, and novelty before it can enter a brief. Items that pass are raised in the brief, which says what changed and what needs attention. Items that do not pass go to a discard log, recorded rather than dropped, so the filter can be audited. Both outcomes are written down.
